text: Could our universe have been born inside a black hole and kept its parent's spin like a birthmark? Think of a ceiling as the loudest a whisper could possibly be. We read all four published papers, the whole four-linked chain, and calculated that ceiling. No observable signature survives. Even the loudest signal is about 10,000 to 100,000 times quieter than the best possible galaxy count, like a whisper buried under a stadium. The route stays closed. Here's how we got there.
